# Shadowkin
They are slow breathers, taking a long time before requiring internals when in a vacuum. They have innate, toggleable night vision.
Their unarmed claw attacks deal Slash damage instead of Blunt.
Stun times from flashes are doubled. They take 25% more brute damage. They take 40% more heat damage. They take 50% less asphyxiation damage
## Light Exposure
Depending on the light level they are exposed to, Shadowkin gain the following effects:
Light Exposure: Dark - Passive Regeneration is buffed.
Light Exposure: Low - No Buffs or Nerfs.
Light Exposure: Annoying - Passive Regeneration is disabled.
Light Exposure: High - You gain a heavy slowdown.
Light Exposure: EXTREME - You begin to take 1 heat damage per second exposed.
## Shadowkin Naming Conventions
Shadowkin typically take up one of three types of naming conventions. The first is a word which exists in their native language. The second is a name which denotes their current or a former position in society. The third is a name which is based off of an aspect of nature. ## Lore
Once hidden away in the darkest crevices of their origin world, Mars, the Shadowkin are a very reserved species. As such, much of their culture is a mystery to the majority of the galaxy. What is known is that many take on names after an object, role, or sound sequence that is significant to them. One of the few things that can be gleamed is that the environment of their culture, despite being on a planet far different from Earth and underground, must include concepts which exist on Earth, as evidenced by Shadowkin who are named after pieces of nature which have yet to be found naturally occurring on Mars.
